entries.title: A task's Activity hears from the tasks linked to it
entries.body: A task's Activity now shows what happened to its parts, its follow-ups and the tasks it waits for: when one starts, opens a pull request, merges or is dropped, and why. When Firstmate drops a task for another, Activity names the replacement and tells you when it merges. A merge that could not run leaves a line, and replies under a task's cards show there too. Each line names the other task, and its key opens that task.

picture.alt: A task's Activity with lines from its part, its dropped follow-up and that follow-up's replacement, which merged pull request #977
